new_value: Wrote docs/ca-lichen-tech-design.md (335 lines) covering all 7 decision areas: (1) offline Ed25519 root + online HSM issuing CA w/ pre-provisioned spare; (2) root in offline air-gapped HSM (YubiHSM/Nitrokey), 2-of-3 Shamir backup, issuing key in online cloud HSM; (3) issuer-signed CA CRL (30-day nextUpdate) via CoAP /.well-known/ca-crl + HTTPS, root cRLSign fallback, no node-cert OCSP per profile; (4) 30-day node certs auto-renewable, 1-yr issuer, 20-yr root; (5) Stripe/ID.me/CLEAR identity verification with attestation outcome kept OFF the cert (CA records only) since x5chain is cleartext; (6) cross-signing = CA-key binding only, pathLen=0 + keyUsage keyCertSign, root-ceremony; (7) free individual tier / paid org tier per Let's Encrypt model. 3x codereview (correctness+security via kimi-k3 reviewer; edge-cases self-reviewed after reviewer timeouts) surfaced 10 findings across 2 rounds, all fixed and re-verified 5/5 clean.
